What does RICE stand for?
The acronym RICE stands for Rest, Ice, Compression, and Elevation.
Rest - It's important not to use the injured body part at all if possible.
Ice - Apply ice immediately to reduce swelling and pain.
Compression - Wrap the injury with an elastic bandage but do not wrap too tightly as this can cause more damage.
Elevation - Keep the injured area elevated above heart level when resting to help reduce swelling.
